label: Bonus buy
standfirst: Paying to skip the base game changes the maths: most feature buys price the round at 20× to 100× stake and the published RTP of the bought round is often lower than the base game.

label: Megaways
standfirst: Reel heights change every spin, up to 117,649 ways to win. High hit frequency, thin individual wins, and licensed to dozens of studios — quality varies wildly.

label: Jackpot
standfirst: Progressive pools are funded out of the base return, which is why jackpot slots publish the lowest RTPs on the index. You are paying for the tail.

label: Cluster pays
standfirst: Wins pay on groups of adjacent symbols rather than lines, with tumbling refills. Longer sessions, more small wins, the same house edge.

label: High volatility
standfirst: Long dry spells and rare large hits. The RTP is identical to a low-variance game over infinite spins — your bankroll is not infinite.
